what_it_is: The report skeleton arm (e) prefills into the emission (DeepSeek beta prefix completion), and names in the context on the Sonnet transport, where nothing can be prefilled.
ports_set: the report's section order: the part-by-part table first, the method's other sections after it
the mark column's vocabulary: the eight marks, written into the emission before the reader writes anything
the table's columns: number, part, mark, holder, provenance
the first row's number: the reader's first written token comes after '| 1 | '
why_these: W8 part B10: 'A harness that writes tokens into the emission, or fixes its shape - a prefilled report skeleton, a closed list the marks must come from - sets ports that the organization's own components assign.' The list above is what arm (e) must name when P4.4 is read (W3 section 8: 'the arm names which ports it set').
sonnet_control: On the Sonnet transport the same text is placed in the context with the instruction to fill it in. W8 part B10 says that is a change to what the call reads and sets no such port, so the Sonnet arm (e) is the control and not the test (W10 section 10).
